question: Why did the network_spillover family IC go negative 2024-26: crowding (a), regime interaction (b), or construction drift (c)?

detail: (c) drift REJECTED (recompute-vs-frozen corr 0.996; PIT+nonPIT both flip; constant-universe flips); (b) regime REJECTED (no axis FDR-significant pre-2024; counterfactual predicts +0.031 vs observed -0.011; 28% of placebos more pessimistic); (a) crowding NOT CONFIRMED (S1 fail: no 2021-23 inflow build-up, z +0.15; S2 weak pass). Default action: R-A price gate (two consecutive positive family month-ends re-arm). Flip is real: family IC +0.023 (NW-t 4.0) 2012-23 -> -0.012 post-2024, break 2024-04, slow horizons died first, combiner negative only 2026H1.
